Metadata.title: ILG — Industrial Floor Scrubbers & Steam Cleaning Equipment
Metadata.description: ILG brings you a focused portfolio of industry-leading cleaning machinery — silent floor care from Klinmak, chemical-free dry steam from Tecnovap. Steam cleaning equipment for manufacturing, food production, and power plants.

Home.contactSubtitle: ILG helps customers find the best premium cleaning brands. Get in touch and we'll help you find the perfect solution.
Home.contactBrandContext: Whether you need floor scrubbing machines from Klinmak or industrial steam cleaners from Tecnovap, our team is ready to assist with consultation, quotes, and after-sales support.

KlinmakPage.heroSubtitle: KlinMak® floor scrubber-dryers represent a new frontier in professional cleaning efficiency, combining maximum performance and reduced energy consumption.
jokerLeft: Klinmak's walk-behind industrial floor scrubbers combine ergonomic design with high performance, delivering professional cleaning results even in medium-sized spaces.
Easy to operate, they ensure spotless floors with minimal effort.
jokerRight: All our machines are ready to use and come complete with lithium battery and charger, 2 or 4 brushes, and a standard Hepa H13 filter.
The range includes 3 models with 50-liter tanks and cleaning paths from 40 cm to 70 cm.
miniLeft: Klinmak's compact walk-behind floor scrubbers are the perfect choice for narrow or hard-to-reach spaces.
Thanks to advanced technology and a modular design, they deliver flawless results while ensuring energy savings and ease of use.
miniRight: All machines are also available complete with lithium battery and charger, equipped with 2 or 4 brushes and a standard Hepa H13 filter.
The range includes 3 models, from 12 to 30 liters, with cleaning paths from 40 to 70 cm.
KlinmakPage.footerPara1: Klinmak is the ideal partner for companies looking for cutting-edge solutions in professional floor cleaning. Our machines combine Italian craftsmanship with innovative technology to deliver exceptional cleaning results.
KlinmakPage.footerPara2: Founded in 2014, we have established ourselves as a leading Italian manufacturer based in Milan province. We specialize in professional and industrial floor scrubbers, offering 100% Made in Italy solutions distributed globally through selected partners across hospitality, healthcare, retail, and industrial sectors.

TecnovapPage.heroSubtitle: World leading manufacturer of high‑quality steam cleaners
values: Quality in products and in the commercial relationships we establish — technical support that makes our steam cleaners truly valuable and durable
Continuous innovation in the steam cleaning sector, creating new technologies to meet every customer need
Protection of the environment, with a cleaning method that has a reduced environmental footprint compared to traditional techniques
Trust, reliability and respect in all internal and external relationships
TecnovapPage.footerPara1: Founded in 1985 in Negrar di Valpolicella (Verona) as a small family-run artisan business with a clear objective: to produce boilers for steam generators with technologies that were already cutting-edge for that time.
TecnovapPage.footerPara2: With 40 years of experience, the company continues to proceed towards constant improvement of its products and affirms its firm presence not only in the domestic sphere, but also in the professional and industrial sectors. Tecnovap is a leading company in the steam cleaning sector among the domestic and foreign companies it works with.

KlinmakWhyChoose.heading: Why choose <accent>KlinMak</accent>?
KlinmakWhyChoose.continuousImprovementBody: For us, innovating means creating new machines, different from all existing ones. It is a demanding job, but we do it with passion — and we have shown that we know how.
KlinmakWhyChoose.twoOrFourBrushesBody: All our machines (excluding vibrating ones) have two or four brushes thanks to the unique KlinMak mechanism (patented). Cleaning is significantly better than with a single brush.
KlinmakWhyChoose.lithiumBatteriesBody: Our floor scrubber-dryers use only lithium batteries, halving the weight, improving handling and speeding up recharging.
KlinmakWhyChoose.lowMaintenanceBody: We use only high-quality components, reducing maintenance activities — resulting in both time and money savings.
KlinmakWhyChoose.immediateAvailabilityBody: Whether you need a machine or spare parts, we deliver quickly — keeping your operations running without downtime.
KlinmakWhyChoose.technicalSupportBody: Have a question or an issue? You can contact us anytime, every day — expert technical support is always within reach.
KlinmakWhyChoose.extendedWarrantyBody: Our machines in the Joker range are covered by a 36-month warranty.
KlinmakWhyChoose.minimumNoiseBody: Our machines are extremely quiet, perfect for environments where noise is a problem, such as hospitals, offices, supermarkets…
KlinmakWhyChoose.energySavingBody: Our machines use very little energy and, thanks to lithium batteries, you save time and money.

KlinmakProductsBanner.headline: Each of our products is designed to meet the needs of hygiene and <accent>sustainability</accent> — a concrete, tangible commitment that goes beyond mere words.

TecnovapBenefits.explainerBody1a: Dry steam cleaners use superheated steam with an incredibly low moisture content to blast dirt, grease, soils and debris from surfaces — leaving them virtually dry and free of residual moisture, without harsh chemicals. The same heat also removes bacteria, allergens and mold on contact. Ideal for chemical-free
TecnovapBenefits.explainerBody1b: in bakeries, snack production plants and manufacturing facilities where degreasing and surface sanitation are essential.
TecnovapBenefits.explainerHeading2: How well do dry vapor steam cleaners work?

TecnovapBeltCleaningBanner.lead: Save labor and time with ILG Cleaning Solutions conveyor-belt cleaning systems — designed for bakery, snacks, confectionery, pharmaceutical, and any other industrial conveying line that demands the highest level of cleaning and hygiene.
TecnovapBeltCleaningBanner.column1Body1a: The system uses the power of
TecnovapBeltCleaningBanner.column1Body1b: steam to quickly remove allergens, mold, glaze, oil overspray, bacteria, fats, grime, and soils. A connected vacuum system extracts the emulsified soils, leaving the belt clean and dry.
TecnovapBeltCleaningBanner.column1Body2: Dry-steam belt cleaning saves labor, decreases sanitation time, and increases productivity with faster changeovers.
TecnovapBeltCleaningBanner.column2Body1: Each conveyor-belt cleaning system can be customized to meet your exact requirements — ideal for large or small manufacturers running multiple product lines.
TecnovapBeltCleaningBanner.column2Body2: State-of-the-art solutions, deployed worldwide to keep flat conveyor belts hygienic, compliant, and ready for the next run.
TecnovapBeltCleaningBanner.benefit1: Designed for cleaning flat conveyor-belt systems
TecnovapBeltCleaningBanner.benefit2: Dry steam with vacuum extraction for quick cleaning and sanitation
TecnovapBeltCleaningBanner.benefit4: Leaves belts dry and ready for sanitation
TecnovapBeltCleaningBanner.benefit5: Removes allergens, mold, glaze, oil overspray, bacteria, fats, grime, and soils
TecnovapBeltCleaningBanner.benefit6: Removes adhesives, oils, and paper residues
TecnovapBeltCleaningBanner.benefit8: Improves production-line flexibility and changeover times
TecnovapBeltCleaningBanner.benefit9: Helps meet stringent quality and FSMA requirements
